candidate_profiles.product: AMD Kria K26 SOM (commercial K26C; exact ordering code and revision to be frozen)
candidate_profiles.recommended_role: first Symthaea HDC/CfC FPGA accelerator research host

power.boundary_note: SOM published values, not measured complete-carrier or system wall power

unresolved_before_schematic: exact commercial or industrial ordering code, hardware revision and datasheet revision
exact carrier connector pin map and bank voltage allocation
resource allocation between PS GTR, PL GTH, clocks and external interfaces
whether required PCIe and storage routes can coexist in the selected topology
boot-source, secure-boot, recovery and firmware lifecycle requirements
measured thermal envelope under target HDC/CfC workloads
module availability, authorized distributors, lifecycle and approved alternates
carrier stack-up, controlled impedance, insertion loss, power integrity and EMC requirements
negative_controls: do not treat FPGA logic cells or DSP count as workload throughput
do not treat module power specification as measured board power
do not assume every transceiver mode is available simultaneously
do not infer ASIC PPA, fabricated silicon or manufacturing yield from FPGA resource counts

candidate_profiles.product: Raspberry Pi Compute Module 5 (exact RAM/eMMC/wireless SKU to be frozen)
candidate_profiles.recommended_role: low-cost management, telemetry, controller and edge carrier profile
unresolved_before_schematic: exact memory and eMMC SKU and current lifecycle sourcing
carrier design guide revision and exact connector pinout
PCIe x1 bandwidth sufficiency for each intended peripheral workload
power/thermal measurements on the selected carrier and enclosure
boot, update, recovery, security and long-term OS support profile
negative_controls: do not assume PCIe x1 is adequate for a high-throughput HDC accelerator
do not treat product-family RAM options as one physical configuration
do not treat production commitment as proof of distributor stock or second source

candidate_profiles.product: PICMG COM-HPC Client or Mini module family (vendor/model not yet selected)
candidate_profiles.recommended_role: future repairable high-bandwidth workstation or edge-server platform

published_standard_capabilities.boundary_note: maximum standard-level capabilities; the selected module implements only its declared subset

unresolved_before_schematic: specific module vendor, CPU, ISA, silicon generation and module revision
specific lane map and whether lanes are PCIe, Ethernet, USB4 or other function
memory topology, capacity, ECC, soldered versus socketed implementation
module power budget, cooling solution and carrier power design
BIOS/UEFI, BMC, secure boot, firmware updates and lifecycle commitments
exact connector footprint, stack height, mechanical keep-outs and PCB stack-up
pricing, supply, approved alternates and regional availability
negative_controls: do not claim that every COM-HPC module exposes all maximum standard capabilities
do not use UCIe as a motherboard or carrier connector
do not freeze a generic carrier before selecting an exact module pinout

candidate_profiles.product: Radiona / EMARD ULX3S, ECP5-85F variant (exact board revision and SDRAM SKU to be frozen)
candidate_profiles.recommended_role: portable RTL/logic proof and early physical HDC primitive prototype under an open FPGA toolchain

open_toolchain.value: Yosys synth_ecp5 -> nextpnr-ecp5 -> Project Trellis/ecppack -> openFPGALoader

board_design_files.value: KiCad source and documentation available upstream

caveats: Exact board revision, FPGA speed grade, package, SDRAM vendor/density and constraint file must be frozen.
Project Trellis/nextpnr ECP5 support is evolving and some features remain incomplete/experimental; verify the exact EBR/BRAM, PLL, SERDES and SDRAM requirements rather than assuming complete support.
The open-flow lane is a portability/prototype path, not production signoff or an industrial safety qualification.
Do not compare throughput/energy to K26 without normalizing the exact host, external memory and workload boundary.
Open-hardware board design does not establish local manufacturing or parts sourcing.
negative_controls: do not claim the open toolchain supports every hard macro or high-speed primitive
do not claim the ULX3S board is a K26-equivalent SoC
do not treat SDRAM capacity as on-chip block RAM

pcie_and_nvme.rule: choose lane count, generation, topology, power and signal-integrity budgets from the exact selected module and SSD/controller

cxl.rule: only claim a working CXL topology when an identified compatible host, switch/device, firmware, driver and physical link are present

ucie.rule: package-level die-to-die chiplet interface; not a motherboard connector

nvme_computational_programs.rule: a ratified command set does not prove that a selected SSD implements it; require device capability discovery and actual execution evidence

benchmark_references.name: SPEC CPU 2026
benchmark_references.coverage: 52 benchmarks in integer/floating-point speed and rate suites; optional energy metrics
benchmark_references.use: general-purpose CPU/compiler/memory context when licensing and run rules are satisfied

benchmark_references.name: MLPerf Inference v6.1
benchmark_references.coverage: includes end-to-end RAG and Edge Agentic Inference workloads
benchmark_references.use: AI system-level context; use exact applicable workload and rules

benchmark_references.name: MLPerf Storage v3.0
benchmark_references.coverage: adds vector database and KV-cache workloads plus S3 access layer
benchmark_references.use: storage supply-path and data-placement context; results are workload-specific

claim_ceiling.fpga: exact board and bitstream observation only
claim_ceiling.physical_carrier: exact revision, assembled BOM and tested configuration only
claim_ceiling.manufacturing: board assembly does not imply semiconductor fabrication
claim_ceiling.sota: requires matched workload, full system boundary, independent baseline and reproducible raw results

mandatory_reference.document: AMD Kria SOM Carrier Card Design Guide UG1091
required_review_topics: SOM connector pinout and bank voltage allocation
PS-GTR and K26 GTH signal routing and reference clocks
power input, sequencing, rail limits and power integrity
timing models, control/configuration signals and sideband
connector footprint, reflow, assembly and mechanical standoff

evaluation_kit_exception.product: AMD Kria KV260 Vision AI Starter Kit
evaluation_kit_exception.warning: Do not transfer the commercial K26C SOM's 16 GB eMMC specification to the KV260 evaluation-kit SOM.

carrier_card_design_gate.execution_gate: Qualify on an identified evaluation platform and exact SOM/board revision before custom carrier schematic freeze.

core_tier.feature_note: CORE provides broader simulation/debug features than BASIC; exact IP/flow feature tier must be checked

caveats: MSRP is not South African retail pricing or evidence of local stock.
